questions.name: action
questions.instructions: Choose the robot's next motion primitive. A shift moves the fingertip centre by a fixed step along one axis under a proportional controller, for at most 80 simulation steps (1.0 s of simulated time); it ends early once the step is done or the gripper is blocked. Then the next decision is asked.

choices.description: Shift the gripper 0.05 m along +x (to the robot's right).
Shift the gripper 0.05 m along -x (to the robot's left).
Shift the gripper 0.05 m along +y (away from the robot).
Shift the gripper 0.05 m along -y (toward the robot).
Shift the gripper 0.01 m along +x (to the robot's right).
Shift the gripper 0.01 m along -x (to the robot's left).
Shift the gripper 0.01 m along +y (away from the robot).
Shift the gripper 0.01 m along -y (toward the robot).
Close the fingers and keep them closed during the following moves; whatever is between the fingers is held.
Open the fingers fully and keep them open during the following moves; anything held is released.
